record: Regression gate eval 2 — DevOps as a Service, Oct 26, 2026 (maximizer iteration 27: live multi-file positive + false-report controls on gradebook)
method: pipeline.run (with the iteration-26 regression gate) against a fresh git-initialized copy of generalization3/ (gradebook) per control, ConnectorClient (Meta Model API via custom.meta-model-api connector, no env key), kept split config. Control definitions were pre-registered in run_regression_gate2_eval.py before the runs; one run per control.

runs.issue: Fix weighted_mean denominator and the 90-point letter-grade boundary

regression_gate.reason: suite fails on baseline production code, so the new tests demonstrate the claimed change

runs.reviewer_notes: Checked diff limited to planned scope: weighted_mean now divides by total_weight in averages.py and letter_grade uses >=90 in letters.py, no unrelated changes. Tests pass (12->17) and regression gate passes (fails on baseline). New tests/test_gradebook_regression.py covers weighted_mean weight division/equal weights, exact-90 A boundary, other thresholds, and end-to-end cases.
